$comment: Deep-research verdicts for census records that were RESEARCH_REQUIRED (no website) or ACTIVE_LIMITED_DATA. Each verdict records what could be independently verified and its claim_type. No URLs/capabilities/categories invented; UNKNOWN where unverified. Records verified as NOT transformer manufacturers (retailer/distributor/service) are flagged with is_transformer_manufacturer=false and kept flagged for review, never auto-deleted.

verdicts.name: National Transformer Company (Saudi Voltamp)
verdicts.parent: Voltamp Energy (Oman) — holds ~80% after raising from 49%
verdicts.note: Confirmed power-transformer manufacturer with a plant near Jeddah; majority-owned by Voltamp Energy (Oman). The Saudi JV has no separately-owned official site (parent site voltampoman.com). kV/MVA unverified.
